## 👋🏻 什么是SwanLab SwanLab 是一款**AI训练分析与指标观测平台**，面向模型训练团队，提供训练可视化、自动日志记录、超参数记录、实验对比、多人协同等功能，帮助团队快速发现训练问题，加速模型迭代。 在SwanLab上，研究者能基于直观的可视化图表发现训练问题，对比多个实验找到研究灵感，并通过**在线网页**的分享与基于组织的**多人协同训练**，打破团队沟通的壁垒，提高组织训练效率。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7965fec4-c8b0-4956-803d-dbf177b44f54 以下是其核心特性列表： **1. 📊 实验指标与超参数跟踪**: 极简的代码嵌入您的机器学习 pipeline，跟踪记录训练关键指标 - ☁️ 支持**云端**使用（类似Weights & Biases），随时随地查看训练进展。[手机看实验的方法](https://docs.swanlab.cn/guide_cloud/general/app.html) - 📝 支持**超参数记录**、**指标总结**、**表格分析** - 🌸 **可视化训练过程**: 通过UI界面对实验跟踪数据进行可视化，可以让训练师直观地看到实验每一步的结果，分析指标走势，判断哪些变化导致了模型效果的提升，从而整体性地提升模型迭代效率。 - **支持的元数据类型**：标量指标、图像、音频、文本、视频、3D点云、生物化学分子、Echarts自定义图表... ![swanlab-table](readme_files/molecule.gif) - **支持的图表类型**：折线图、媒体图（图像、音频、文本、视频）、3D点云、生物化学分子、柱状图、散点图、箱线图、热力图、饼状图、雷达图、[自定义图表](https://docs.swanlab.cn/guide_cloud/experiment_track/log-custom-chart.html)... [![swanlab-echarts](readme_files/echarts.png)](https://swanlab.cn/@ZeyiLin/swanlab-echarts-demo/charts) - **LLM生成内容可视化组件**：为大语言模型训练场景打造的文本内容可视化图表，支持Markdown渲染 ![text-chart](readme_files/text-chart.gif) - **后台自动记录**：日志logging、硬件环境、Git 仓库、Python 环境、Python 库列表、项目运行目录 - **断点续训记录**：支持在训练完成/中断后，补充新的指标数据到同个实验中 **2. ⚡️ 全面的框架集成**: PyTorch、🤗HuggingFace Transformers、PyTorch Lightning、🦙LLaMA Factory、MMDetection、Ultralytics、PaddleDetection、LightGBM、XGBoost、Keras、TensorBoard、Weights&Biases、Swift、XTuner、Stable-Baselines3、Hydra 在内的 **30+** 框架 ![](readme_files/integrations.png) **3. 💻 硬件监控**: 支持实时记录与监控CPU、NPU（**昇腾Ascend**）、GPU（**英伟达Nvidia**）、AMD（**AMD ROCm**）、MLU（**寒武纪Cambricon**）、XPU（**昆仑芯Kunlunxin**）、DCU（**海光DCU**）、MetaX GPU（**沐曦XPU**）、Moore Threads GPU（**摩尔线程**）、Iluvatar GPU（**天数智芯**）、内存的系统级硬件指标 **4. 📦 实验管理**: 通过专为训练场景设计的集中式仪表板，通过整体视图速览全局，快速管理多个项目与实验 **5. 🆚 比较结果**: 通过在线表格与对比图表比较不同实验的超参数和结果，挖掘迭代灵感 ![](readme_files/swanlab-table.png) **6. 👥 在线协作**: 您可以与团队进行协作式训练，支持将实验实时同步在一个项目下，您可以在线查看团队的训练记录，基于结果发表看法与建议 **7. ✉️ 分享结果**: 复制和发送持久的 URL 来共享每个实验，方便地发送给伙伴，或嵌入到在线笔记中 **8. 💻 支持自托管**: 支持离线环境使用，自托管的社区版同样可以查看仪表盘与管理实验，[使用攻略](#-自托管) **9. 🔌 插件拓展**: 支持通过插件拓展SwanLab的使用场景，比如 [飞书通知](https://docs.swanlab.cn/plugin/notification-lark.html)、[Slack通知](https://docs.swanlab.cn/plugin/notification-slack.html)、[CSV记录器](https://docs.swanlab.cn/plugin/writer-csv.html)等 > \[!IMPORTANT] > > **收藏项目**，你将从 GitHub 上无延迟地接收所有发布通知～ ⭐️ ![star-us](readme_files/star-us.png)

## 🏁 快速开始 ### 1.安装 ```bash pip install swanlab ```
源码安装 如果你想体验最新的特性，可以使用源码安装。 ```bash # 方式一 git clone https://github.com/SwanHubX/SwanLab.git pip install -e . # 方式二 pip install git+https://github.com/SwanHubX/SwanLab.git ```
离线看板拓展安装 [离线看板文档](https://docs.swanlab.cn/guide_cloud/offline-board.html) ```bash pip install 'swanlab[dashboard]' ```
### 2.登录并获取 API Key 1. 免费[注册账号](https://swanlab.cn) 2. 登录账号，在用户设置 > [API Key](https://swanlab.cn/settings) 里复制您的 API Key 3. 打开终端，输入： ```bash swanlab login ``` 出现提示时，输入您的 API Key，按下回车，完成登陆。 ### 3.将 SwanLab 与你的代码集成 ```python import swanlab # 初始化一个新的swanlab实验 swanlab.init( project="my-first-ml", config={"learning-rate": 0.003}, ) # 记录指标 for i in range(10): swanlab.log({"loss": i, "acc": i}) ``` 大功告成！前往[SwanLab](https://swanlab.cn)查看你的第一个 SwanLab 实验。

## 🆚 与熟悉的工具的比较 ### Tensorboard vs SwanLab - **☁️ 支持在线使用**： 通过 SwanLab 可以方便地将训练实验在云端在线同步与保存，便于远程查看训练进展、管理历史项目、分享实验链接、发送实时消息通知、多端看实验等。而 Tensorboard 是一个离线的实验跟踪工具。 - **👥 多人协作**： 在进行多人、跨团队的机器学习协作时，通过 SwanLab 可以轻松管理多人的训练项目、分享实验链接、跨空间交流讨论。而 Tensorboard 主要为个人设计，难以进行多人协作和分享实验。 - **💻 持久、集中的仪表板**： 无论你在何处训练模型，无论是在本地计算机上、在实验室集群还是在公有云的 GPU 实例中，你的结果都会记录到同一个集中式仪表板中。而使用 TensorBoard 需要花费时间从不同的机器复制和管理 TFEvent 文件。 - **💪 更强大的表格**： 通过 SwanLab 表格可以查看、搜索、过滤来自不同实验的结果，可以轻松查看数千个模型版本并找到适合不同任务的最佳性能模型。 TensorBoard 不适用于大型项目。 ### Weights and Biases vs SwanLab - Weights and Biases 是一个必须联网使用的闭源 MLOps 平台 - SwanLab 不仅支持联网使用，也支持开源、免费、自托管的版本

## 👋🏻 What is SwanLab SwanLab is an **AI training analytics and metrics observability platform** built for model training teams. It provides **training visualization, automated logging, hyperparameter tracking, experiment comparison, and multi-user collaboration** to help teams diagnose training anomalies early and accelerate model iteration. With SwanLab, researchers can spot training bottlenecks through intuitive interactive charts, compare multiple runs side by side to uncover insights, and eliminate team communication silos via **web-based sharing** and **organization-level collaborative workspaces**. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7965fec4-c8b0-4956-803d-dbf177b44f54 Key features include: **1. 📊 Experiment Metrics & Hyperparameter Tracking**: Instrument your ML pipeline with minimal code to track and log critical training metrics. - ☁️ **Cloud-Ready** (similar to Weights & Biases): Monitor training progress anytime, anywhere. [View experiments on mobile](https://docs.swanlab.cn/en/guide_cloud/general/app.html). - 📝 Supports **hyperparameter logging**, **metric summaries**, and **tabular analysis**. - 🌸 **Training Visualization**: Visualize experiment tracking data through an interactive UI to inspect step-by-step dynamics, analyze metric trajectories, and pinpoint which architectural or hyperparameter changes drive model improvements. - **Supported Metadata Types**: Scalar metrics, images, audio, text, video, 3D point clouds, molecular structures, custom ECharts... ![swanlab-table](readme_files/molecule.gif) - **Supported Chart Types**: Line charts, media panels (images, audio, text, video), 3D point clouds, molecular viewers, bar charts, scatter plots, box plots, heatmaps, pie charts, radar charts, [custom charts](https://docs.swanlab.cn/en/guide_cloud/experiment_track/log-custom-chart.html)... [![swanlab-echarts](readme_files/echarts.png)](https://swanlab.cn/@ZeyiLin/swanlab-echarts-demo/charts) - **LLM Generation Visualizer**: Purpose-built text visualization component for LLM training workflows with native Markdown rendering. ![text-chart](readme_files/text-chart.gif) - **Automated Background Logging**: Console logs (`stdout`/`stderr`), hardware specs, Git repository state, Python runtime environment, installed packages, and working directory. - **Checkpoint & Run Resumption**: Seamlessly append new metrics to an existing run after training interruption or completion. **2. ⚡️ Comprehensive Framework Integrations**: Out-of-the-box integration with **30+** frameworks including PyTorch, 🤗HuggingFace Transformers, PyTorch Lightning, 🦙LLaMA Factory, MMDetection, Ultralytics, PaddleDetection, LightGBM, XGBoost, Keras, TensorBoard, Weights & Biases, MS-Swift, XTuner, Stable-Baselines3, and Hydra. ![](readme_files/integrations.png) **3. 💻 System & Accelerator Monitoring**: Real-time tracking of system-level hardware metrics across CPU, NPU (**Huawei Ascend**), GPU (**NVIDIA**), AMD (**AMD ROCm**), MLU (**Cambricon**), XPU (**Kunlunxin**), DCU (**Hygon**), MetaX GPU (**MetaX**), Moore Threads GPU (**Moore Threads**), Iluvatar GPU (**Iluvatar CoreX**), and system memory. **4. 📦 Centralized Experiment Management**: Gain a bird's-eye view of all projects and runs through a centralized dashboard tailored for ML workloads. **5. 🆚 Side-by-Side Run Comparison**: Compare hyperparameters and metrics across runs using interactive tables and overlay plots to guide model iteration. ![](readme_files/swanlab-table.png) **6. 👥 Team Collaboration**: Train collaboratively by syncing runs in real time under shared team projects, reviewing teammates' experiments, and discussing findings online. **7. ✉️ Effortless Sharing**: Share persistent URLs for individual runs with collaborators or embed live charts directly into online docs and notebooks. **8. 💻 Self-Hosting Support**: Deploy in air-gapped or on-premises environments with the self-hosted Community Edition to view dashboards and manage experiments locally. See the [Self-Hosting Guide](#-self-hosting). **9. 🔌 Extensible Plugin Ecosystem**: Extend SwanLab workflows via plugins such as [Lark Notifications](https://docs.swanlab.cn/en/plugin/notification-lark.html), [Slack Notifications](https://docs.swanlab.cn/en/plugin/notification-slack.html), [CSV Logger](https://docs.swanlab.cn/en/plugin/writer-csv.html), and more. > \[!IMPORTANT] > > **Star this repository** to receive instant notifications for all new releases on GitHub! ⭐️ ![star-us](readme_files/star-us.png)

## 🏁 Quick Start ### 1. Installation ```bash pip install swanlab ```
Install from Source To try out the latest bleeding-edge features, install directly from source: ```bash # Option 1: Editable install git clone https://github.com/SwanHubX/SwanLab.git pip install -e . # Option 2: Install via Git URL pip install git+https://github.com/SwanHubX/SwanLab.git ```
Install Offline Dashboard Extension [Offline Dashboard Documentation](https://docs.swanlab.cn/en/guide_cloud/offline-board.html) ```bash pip install 'swanlab[dashboard]' ```
### 2. Log In & Configure API Key 1. Sign up for a free account at [SwanLab](https://swanlab.cn). 2. Log in and copy your API Key from **User Settings** > [API Key](https://swanlab.cn/settings). 3. Open your terminal and run: ```bash swanlab login ``` Paste your API Key when prompted and press Enter to complete authentication. ### 3. Integrate SwanLab into Your Training Script ```python import swanlab # Initialize a new SwanLab run swanlab.init( project="my-first-ml", config={"learning-rate": 0.003}, ) # Log metrics during training for i in range(10): swanlab.log({"loss": i, "acc": i}) ``` That's it! Head over to [SwanLab](https://swanlab.cn) to inspect your first experiment run.

## 🆚 Comparison with Alternatives ### TensorBoard vs. SwanLab - **☁️ Cloud-Native Sync & Remote Access**: SwanLab syncs and stores training runs in the cloud, making it effortless to monitor progress remotely, manage historical projects, share experiment links, receive real-time alerts, and inspect runs across devices. TensorBoard is strictly a local, offline visualization viewer. - **👥 Built-In Team Collaboration**: For multi-user, cross-team ML workflows, SwanLab provides shared workspaces to organize team projects, share permanent links, and collaborate on findings. TensorBoard is designed for single-user local inspection and lacks native collaboration features. - **💻 Persistent, Centralized Dashboard**: Whether you train on a local workstation, an on-prem cluster, or public cloud GPU instances, SwanLab aggregates all runs into a single centralized dashboard. With TensorBoard, you have to manually copy and manage `tfevents` files across machines. - **💪 Scalable Tabular Analytics**: SwanLab's interactive tables let you view, search, sort, and filter metrics and hyperparameters across thousands of model runs to quickly identify top-performing checkpoints. TensorBoard struggles to scale to large numbers of runs. ### Weights & Biases vs. SwanLab - **Weights & Biases** is a proprietary, closed-source MLOps platform that requires cloud connectivity or paid enterprise licensing. - **SwanLab** offers both a full-featured cloud service and an **open-source, free, self-hosted edition** suitable for air-gapped and private infrastructure.
